deadline.value: The Fall priority deadline is January 5; the general Fall deadline is April 11.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: The page asks applicants to name research groups they would join, but does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: Specifies research interests and those research groups the applicant would be interested in joining

funding.value: The chemistry page does not describe assistantships or stipends.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in chemistry or a related science is required by the start of graduate study.
entry_route.quote: Must have a Bachelor’s degree in chemistry or related science discipline from an accredited institution by the start of the first term of graduate study

toefl_min.value: The chemistry page gives only the old 550 paper-based and 79 internet-based scores, which are not recorded; the Graduate School's 4.5 (new scale) applies.
toefl_min.quote: Official TOEFL scores of 550 or higher (paper-based), 79 or higher (internet-based)

ielts_min.value: The chemistry department states an IELTS overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: official IELTS score of 6.5 overall band
